checks: No music autoplay before explicit start gesture
Start gesture plays menu using one reusable audio element
Battle and boss switch on the same element without overlapping music
Repeated HUD updates never restart the current track
Returning to a paused game does not resume music
Music mute and volume persist independently of SFX
Autoplay rejection is caught and reported
Late play resolution cannot bypass Pause
Rapid pause and resume during pending playback recovers music
Pending play followed by scene change settles on the latest track
Missing music file does not throw or block controls
note: Media lifecycle tested with a controllable HTMLAudio adapter. Actual device playback and autoplay behavior require a browser/device check.
